name: Kokoro Stage 2 Training Safeguards
short_description: JSONL step logger, per-epoch checkpoint manager, health gates, and run config capture for Kokoro StyleTTS2 Stage 2 training.

entry_points.name: StepLogger
entry_points.description: Appends per-step training metrics to a JSONL file for offline analysis.

entry_points.name: CheckpointManager
entry_points.description: Saves per-epoch checkpoints with SHA-256 manifest; replaces top-2 pruning with full retention.

entry_points.name: HealthGate
entry_points.description: Monitors dur_loss, acoustic_norm, val_loss spike, and consecutive NaN skips; fires and exits when a threshold is exceeded.

entry_points.name: capture_run_config
entry_points.description: Saves config YAML and launch_info.json (git SHA, timestamp) at training startup.

entry_points.name: GateResult
entry_points.description: Frozen dataclass returned by HealthGate.check(); carries fired flag, gate name, value, threshold, and last healthy checkpoint path.
